visualCharacteristics.purpose: Multi-column card grid with an optional heading/intro row; the Style option picks the card treatment
visualCharacteristics.description: solutions: bordered 3-up cards with image, category eyebrow, title, Learn More link. productlines: white cards on a grey band. insights: intro panel beside stacked text cards. simple: 4-up cards with tag pill and NEW ribbon. features: centered borderless 3-up columns (title, icon, description). video: 3-up 16:9 Vidyard posters with a play overlay, no text body; clicking inlines the player. showcase: white cards over a full-bleed background image with a centered white heading/subheading; cards with or without images and a Learn more button.

contentPattern.structure: row 0 = heading/intro (rich text; showcase: optional heading + subheading and optional background image, in the heading row or the container Background Image field); rows 1..N = one card each: image cell + rich text cell (title, description, link). video: poster image + paragraph with a link to the video (link text = video title)

usage: Home, About Us, Products and Chemistry pages (solutions, productlines, insights, simple, features); Host Response to Infection solution page (features, video, showcase).
reuseGuidance: Use for multi-column card grids. Use cards-media-list for vertical image-left/text-right resource lists. Use carousel resources when cards must be filterable and paged.
